$comment: The 23 fields `legacy/prompts/11-extraction_key_value_invoice_prompt.yaml` declares, as a JSON Schema the provider constrains generation with. It is a SEPARATE artifact from the prompt on purpose (two artifacts, one per concern): the prompt says what to look for and how to read it, the schema says what shape the answer must have. They are kept in step by `test_the_schema_and_the_prompt_agree_on_the_fields` rather than by being generated from one another.

comprobante_valido.description: 'true' when the text is a readable receipt, 'false' when it is not

motivo_rechazo.description: Why the document was rejected, or 'null'

tipo_comprobante.description: the letter or the AFIP code printed in the header (001 Factura A, 006 Factura B, 011 Factura C), or 'null' when the document is not a fiscal receipt. 090/099 are 'comprobantes que no cumplen la RG 1415', not receipt classes

cuit_emisor.description: the emitter's CUIT, digits and its own hyphens only

moneda.description: the currency the document shows; 'ARS' when it shows none

subtotal.description: as printed - never reformatted into a number

importe_total_facturado.description: the total as printed, with no adjustment

condicion_impositiva_dominante.description: the EMITTER's IVA condition, as the document declares it (RG 259/98 legends), or 'null' when it declares none. Never an alícuota — rates belong in alicuotas_detectadas

alicuotas_detectadas.description: every IVA rate printed on the document, as AFIP codes separated by '|': 0, 2_5, 5, 10_5, 21, 27

categoria_gasto.description: inferred from the emitter's line of business, or 'null' when there is no clear indication

centro_de_costo.description: always 'null' at extraction: filled by a later classification step
